title: Very Charred, Pillowy Jiangsu Noodles Dan-Dan-Mian
description: Charred, pillowy Jiangsu noodles in a savory dan-dan-mian sauce, wrapped in a pandan leaf.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine strong white flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10-15 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a thin sheet.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the noodles until they are charred and pillowy.
In a separate pan, heat sesame oil over medium heat and add grated ginger and minced garlic.
Stir-fry the ginger and garlic mixture until fragrant, then add soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Stir-fry the sauce mixture until it thickens, then add Dan-Dan sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
To assemble the noodles, place a sheet of cooked noodles on a pandan leaf and add a spoonful of sauce mixture.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped scallions, then fold the pandan leaf to form a wrap.
